All files verified. Here is the structured report.

### SUMMARY
Scaffolded the complete `apps/website` Astro project for the Web Noise Cleaner Chrome extension landing page. Created 7 files covering package config, Astro/TypeScript config, a shadcn-themed global CSS, a base layout with theme-toggle script, the main landing page (hero + features + supported sites + footer), and a gitkeep for the public directory.

### EVIDENCE
- `apps/website/package.json` — written with exact package.json content from the task spec (25 lines, 613 bytes)
- `apps/website/astro.config.mjs` — written with Astro config for GitHub Pages (`site`, `base`, react integration)
- `apps/website/tsconfig.json` — written with `astro/tsconfigs/strict` extends, React JSX, and `@/*` path alias
- `apps/website/src/styles/global.css` — written with `@import "tailwindcss"`, `@import "tw-animate-css"`, and `@import "@web-noise-cleaner/ui/styles"`
- `apps/website/src/layouts/Layout.astro` — written with global CSS import, meta tags, theme-detection script (28 lines, 752 bytes)
- `apps/website/src/pages/index.astro` — written with hero section, 3 feature cards, supported-sites grid, footer, and shadcn theme classes (95 lines, 4081 bytes)
- `apps/website/public/.gitkeep` — empty placeholder to ensure public/ directory exists
- Verified all 7 files exist via `list_dir` on each subdirectory

### CHANGES
- `apps/website/package.json` — created with @web-noise-cleaner/website package definition and Astro/React/Tailwind dependencies
- `apps/website/astro.config.mjs` — created with React integration and GitHub Pages site/base config
- `apps/website/tsconfig.json` — created with strict Astro tsconfig, React JSX, and `@/*` path alias
- `apps/website/src/styles/global.css` — created with Tailwind v4, tw-animate-css, and shadcn UI theme imports
- `apps/website/src/layouts/Layout.astro` — created with global CSS import, meta tags, favicon, and inline dark/light theme script
- `apps/website/src/pages/index.astro` — created with hero, 3 feature cards, supported-sites grid, Chrome store + GitHub links, and footer
- `apps/website/public/.gitkeep` — created to materialize empty public/ directory

### RISKS
- **`@import "@web-noise-cleaner/ui/styles"` may not resolve at build time** — If the `@web-noise-cleaner/ui` package does not export a `styles` entry point that Astro's CSS pipeline can `@import`, the build will fail. - **`public/.gitkeep` is an empty placeholder** — A real favicon.png should eventually be placed in `public/` to match `<link rel="icon" href="/web-noise-cleaner/favicon.png" />`.
